content: {"summary":"Customers report that the playback controls vanish while music plays, preventing pause, skip, or stop actions, and the now‑playing bar disappears from the app, lock screen, and notifications panel. The issue also causes songs to stop unexpectedly or continue playing without visible controls, requiring app or phone restarts to restore functionality.
